description: O11: the REFUSAL of the move of a static entity record. IStaticEntity.Records is IEnumerable (the dump of the other job shows the records in an order that does not even repeat from run to run), the reading order is the value of the attribute Order (OrderByAttribute) and the move verb only reorders inside a sequence of the parent; the kernel refuses and says which sequences the parent actually has (Attributes, Metadata). The proven alternative is to write the value of Order (set <record>/Order prop Value), as in tests/jobs/static-entity-lifecycle.json. Measured with the base job:spec-data.
expectError: move: IStaticEntity 'Status' does not keep IRecord 'Active' in an ordered sequence, so there is no order to change
Sequences of this parent: Attributes, Metadata

ops._why: the order that really exists: the value 1 in the Order column of this record. This is what is written to reorder, not the position in the tree.

refused with "op #1 (move ): InvalidOperationException: move: IStaticEntity 'Status' does not keep IRecord 'Active' in an ordered sequence, so there is no order to change (the Studio lists that kind by itself). Sequences of this parent: Attributes, Metadata".
